title: add jsonschema strict-mode validation and improved error reporting (openai-compat)
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Add first-class JSON Schema structured-output support to the API surface with a strict validation mode and improved, OpenAI-compatible error reporting. Motivation: customers are relying on structured outputs for downstream parsing and ingestion; we need a deterministic validation mode and clearer errors for debugging. This PR introduces a response_format=json_schema option, a strict boolean flag, a validator pipeline that runs both streaming-safe prechecks and final post-generation validation, and an OpenAI-compat layer for error payloads. Summary of changes: implement validator pipeline under runtime/jsonschema/validator.go, wire response_format and strict flags in api/types/response_format.go and api/handlers/generate.go, add OpenAI compatibility wrapper in sdk/python/redwood/openai_compat.py and server-side response shaping in api/openai_compat/response_shim.go, update docs and examples. Checklist: 1) schema validation implementation with AJV-inspired rules and custom Redwood hooks, 2) streaming integration to emit partial tokens while ensuring final validation, 3) strict-mode behavior: when strict=true we return 4xx with structured error and include schema path and human-friendly message; when strict=false we attempt a best-effort repair (attempt to coerce types or fall back to top-level string), 4) OpenAI compatibility: error format matches expected openai error.schema_validation with type, message and path fields, 5) extensive unit and integration tests added. Commits: ["implement jsonschema validator and tests","add response_format flag and strict wiring","openai compat error shim and integration tests","docs: jsonschema structured output guide","fix: streaming edge case for partial arrays","tests: add fixtures and edge-case schemas"]. Files changed (high-level): ["api/handlers/generate.go","api/types/response_format.go","runtime/jsonschema/validator.go","runtime/jsonschema/schema_store.go","api/openai_compat/response_shim.go","sdk/python/redwood/openai_compat.py","docs/openai_compat.md","docs/response_format.md","tests/test_jsonschema_strict_mode.py","tests/integration/test_streaming_jsonschema.py","examples/structured-output/product-extraction.json","scripts/generate-jsonschema-fixtures.py"]. Testing: added unit tests covering validation rules, coercion and repair heuristics; integration tests exercise streaming generation with strict and non-strict modes; end-to-end example verified against downstream parser. CI: unit-tests: pass, integration-tests: pass, e2e: pass, lint: pass, benchmarks: baseline run unchanged. Review notes: initial reviewer requested clearer error codes and consistent path formatting, author updated error payloads to include schema path and an RFC-style short code. Addressed streaming regression where multi-chunk arrays could be mis-validated by adding an incremental validator checkpoint. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless response_format=json_schema is used; strict is opt-in. Migration notes: customers using openai-compat that rely on free-form text should not be affected. Release notes: "Add optional JSON Schema structured-output mode with strict validation and OpenAI-compatible error messages. When strict mode is enabled, responses that do not conform to the schema will return a 4xx with a structured error payload. Non-strict mode will attempt best-effort repairs." Related: ENG-4721 tracked rollout plan and telemetry. Merge: squash and merge.
